==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. I walk into a shadow in the forest and appear in a void. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (The void resembles a seemingly endless, empty, black void.)
In the distance, I can see the clearing where Johnson and Gold Wielder are. (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet.) (The Gold Trident Wielder is a flying, sparkling golden, faceless humanoid wielding a glowing, magical, golden trident.)
Using my will power, I escape the infinite void and return to the clearing.
